effect_entries.effect: Inflicts regular damage.  User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.
effect_entries.short_effect: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Le lanceur attaque son adversaire avec son poireau. Toutefois, cette action le fait vaciller et il doit se reposer au tour suivant.
The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.
